reply.text:
I can't give you a dose for Anavar, or for any steroid. Dosing a drug like that is a call for a doctor, and one who knows your health and bloodwork.

As a beginner, the thing that will move you most is boring and works: a solid program, eating enough protein, sleeping, and showing up consistently for the first year or two. Newer lifters tend to progress fast on that alone.

If you want, I can build you a beginner program around your schedule and equipment. Tell me how many days a week you can train.
